summary_for_children: Surah Yusuf tells one complete story: Yusuf's dream, his brothers' jealousy, the well, his patience in Egypt and in prison, the storehouses, and his forgiveness when his family is reunited.
world_title: Yusuf's Journey: From the Well to the Storehouses
environment_concept: Seven connected places follow the surah in order: the night of eleven stars, the well, the caravan road, a house in Egypt, the prison, the storehouses and the reunion hall.
architecture_and_scenery: Canaanite hills at night, a stone well, a desert caravan road, an Egyptian house with gardens, a prison courtyard, granaries along the Nile, and a palace hall.

palette.lighting: Starlight, desert sun, cool interiors, warm palace lamps
palette.atmosphere: Night breeze, dusty road, Nile humidity

areas.name: Night of Eleven Stars
areas.description: A hilltop under eleven bright stars, the sun and the moon.

areas.name: The Well
areas.description: A deep stone well in the wilderness.

areas.name: Caravan Road
areas.description: A desert road with a passing caravan's tracks.

areas.name: The Prison
areas.description: A prison courtyard where dreams are explained.

areas.name: The Storehouses
areas.description: Granaries where grain is stored in its spikes.

areas.name: The Shirt
areas.description: A shirt carried home as a sign.

areas.name: Hall of Reunion
areas.description: A palace hall at the end of the journey; no one is shown.

activities.name: Retell the journey
activities.description: Put the seven places of Yusuf's story in the order the surah tells them, from the dream to the reunion.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

activities.name: Match each place to its ayah
activities.description: Match each place on the road to the ayah it comes from.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

activities.name: Store the harvest
activities.description: Over seven years of plenty, store grain in its spikes; then share it through seven hard years.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

activities.name: Carry the sheaves
activities.description: Carry four sheaves of grain to the granary doors, kept in their spikes for the hard years (12:47).
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

narration_plan: Narration moves place by place in the Quran's order. Yusuf, his family and all others are never shown or voiced.
learning_objectives: Explain how planning helped during hardship

status.playable_environment: first version built: its own road of seven places (stars, well, caravan, prison, granaries, shirt, hall) and two playable games; carry the sheaves to the granaries (hands-on, in the scene)
status.testing: checked in headless Chromium with software WebGL at 1280x800; not tested on phones or real GPUs
status.tested_by: automated screenshots of the scene and the journey game

depiction_rules: No prophet, person or representation of Allah is shown. Unseen realities are never pictured. Interactive activities are labelled as adaptations.
